verdict: Leads aren't registering in reports, but your pipeline tells a different story.
narrative: Google Ads recorded 10 conversions and 124 clicks this period, yet zero leads are showing up in tracked totals — the connection between your ad platform and your contact pipeline is broken, and we're repairing it now. Your Google Business Profile generated 19 calls and 106 total actions in the last 28 days, confirming real business activity is continuing despite what the lead count shows. Ad spend ran at roughly $15 per day over the last week, a significant pullback from earlier in the period, and Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply in the final days — both are being addressed as LSA campaigns re-enable for heating season starting tomorrow, September 1st. Three milestones go live today: the Review Boost campaign, the financing page, and the Homer Glen branch page, all of which support stronger organic and local visibility heading into fall. Heating campaigns on Google and Meta are scheduled for October 1st, with fall creative delivered by end of September.
